title: Advertisement
subtitle: 「廣告」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「廣告」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.note: advertisement 最常見、最自然的簡寫。
words.example: I saw an ad for the new phone online.
words.exampleZh: 我在網上看到那款新手機的廣告。

exercises.original: I saw an advertisement for the new laptop on social media.
exercises.zh: 我在社交媒體上看到那款新筆記型電腦的廣告。
exercises.upgrade: I saw an ad for the new laptop on social media.

options.explanation: 是 advertisement 最直接、最常見的簡寫。
是一整套宣傳活動，不是單一廣告。

exercises.original: The website showed an advertisement before the video started.
exercises.zh: 網站在影片開始前播放了一則廣告。
exercises.upgrade: The website showed an ad before the video started.

options.explanation: 在數碼平台語境中最自然。
不是影片前播放的內容。

exercises.original: The company placed an advertisement in the local newspaper.
exercises.zh: 公司在當地報紙刊登了一則廣告。
exercises.upgrade: The company placed an ad in the local newspaper.

options.explanation: 報紙中的單一廣告很自然用 ad。
不可數，通常不指一則具體廣告。

words.note: 英式英語常見，是 advertisement 的簡寫。
words.example: She responded to a job advert in the newspaper.
words.exampleZh: 她回應了報紙上的一則招聘廣告。

exercises.original: She found the apartment through an advertisement in a local paper.
exercises.zh: 她透過當地報紙上的一則廣告找到這套公寓。
exercises.upgrade: She found the apartment through an advert in a local paper.

options.explanation: 英式英語中是 advertisement 的自然簡寫。

exercises.original: The newspaper carried an advertisement for a teaching position.
exercises.zh: 報紙刊登了一則教師職位廣告。
exercises.upgrade: The newspaper carried an advert for a teaching position.

options.explanation: 招聘資訊可被宣布，但這裡明確是招聘廣告。
在英式英語中特別自然。

exercises.original: He replied to an advertisement for a second-hand bicycle.
exercises.zh: 他回應了一則二手單車廣告。
exercises.upgrade: He replied to an advert for a second-hand bicycle.

words.meaning: 商業廣告；電視／電台廣告
words.note: 指電視、電台、串流平台等播放的商業廣告。
words.example: The commercial aired during the football match.
words.exampleZh: 這則商業廣告在足球比賽期間播出。

exercises.original: The advertisement played during the television break.
exercises.zh: 這則廣告在電視節目中段播放。
exercises.upgrade: The commercial played during the television break.

options.explanation: 電視播出的商業廣告最自然用 commercial。

exercises.original: The company produced a thirty-second advertisement for streaming platforms.
exercises.zh: 公司製作了一段三十秒的串流平台廣告。
exercises.upgrade: The company produced a thirty-second commercial for streaming platforms.

options.explanation: 短影音商業廣告很適合。

exercises.original: That advertisement has been shown on television all week.
exercises.zh: 那則廣告整個星期都在電視上播放。
exercises.upgrade: That commercial has been shown on television all week.

words.note: 可指為產品、活動或品牌進行的宣傳，也可指具體促銷內容。
words.example: The company launched a promotion for its new service.
words.exampleZh: 公司為新服務推出了一項宣傳活動。

exercises.original: The company launched an advertisement for its new subscription service.
exercises.zh: 公司為新的訂閱服務推出宣傳。
exercises.upgrade: The company launched a promotion for its new subscription service.

options.explanation: 推廣新服務時非常自然。
可以宣布新服務，但不等於促銷宣傳。

exercises.original: The store is running an advertisement offering 20% off selected items.
exercises.zh: 商店正在進行一項指定貨品八折的促銷宣傳。
exercises.upgrade: The store is running a promotion offering 20% off selected items.

options.explanation: 折扣活動尤其適合 promotion。
可宣布折扣，但不是促銷本身。

exercises.original: The restaurant created an advertisement to attract more customers during the quiet season.
exercises.zh: 餐廳推出宣傳，希望在淡季吸引更多顧客。
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant created a promotion to attract more customers during the quiet season.

options.explanation: 有明確推廣和吸客目的。

words.note: 指用來推廣產品、服務、品牌或活動的訊息。
words.example: The app displayed a promotional message after login.
words.exampleZh: 應用程式登入後顯示了一則宣傳訊息。

exercises.original: The app displayed an advertisement after the user logged in.
exercises.zh: 使用者登入後，應用程式顯示了一則宣傳訊息。
exercises.upgrade: The app displayed a promotional message after the user logged in.

options.explanation: 數碼介面上的推廣訊息很自然。

exercises.original: The email contained an advertisement for the company's new service.
exercises.zh: 電郵內有一則公司的新服務宣傳訊息。
exercises.upgrade: The email contained a promotional message for the company's new service.

options.explanation: 電郵中的推廣內容很適合。

exercises.original: The platform inserted an advertisement encouraging users to upgrade.
exercises.zh: 平台加入一則鼓勵使用者升級的宣傳訊息。
exercises.upgrade: The platform inserted a promotional message encouraging users to upgrade.

words.note: 指用於推廣的文字、圖片、單張、海報、影片等內容。
words.example: The company distributed promotional material at the event.
words.exampleZh: 公司在活動中派發宣傳材料。

exercises.original: The company distributed advertisements at the trade show.
exercises.zh: 公司在商展中派發宣傳材料。
exercises.upgrade: The company distributed promotional material at the trade show.

options.explanation: 可包括單張、冊子、海報等各類宣傳內容。

exercises.original: The marketing team prepared advertisements for the product launch.
exercises.zh: 營銷團隊為產品發布準備了宣傳材料。
exercises.upgrade: The marketing team prepared promotional material for the product launch.

exercises.original: The event package included advertisements, brochures, and posters.
exercises.zh: 活動資料包包括廣告、宣傳冊和海報等宣傳材料。
exercises.upgrade: The event package included promotional material, including brochures and posters.

options.explanation: 品牌塑造不等於這些具體材料。

words.note: 指帶有推廣目的、旨在影響消費者的市場營銷內容。
words.example: The campaign used a simple marketing message focused on convenience.
words.exampleZh: 這次宣傳活動使用了一個以便利為重點的簡單營銷訊息。

exercises.original: The advertisement focused on how much time the product could save.
exercises.zh: 這則營銷訊息重點強調產品可以節省多少時間。
exercises.upgrade: The marketing message focused on how much time the product could save.

options.explanation: 重點在推廣內容傳達的核心賣點。

exercises.original: The campaign used the same advertisement across several channels.
exercises.zh: 這次宣傳活動在多個渠道使用相同的營銷訊息。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign used the same marketing message across several channels.

options.explanation: 同一核心推廣訊息可跨渠道使用。

exercises.original: The advertisement was designed to make the brand seem more environmentally friendly.
exercises.zh: 這則營銷訊息旨在讓品牌顯得更環保。
exercises.upgrade: The marketing message was designed to make the brand seem more environmentally friendly.

options.explanation: 強調宣傳所傳遞的品牌定位。

words.note: 指使某人、產品、活動或機構獲得公眾注意的宣傳。
words.example: The event received a lot of publicity before opening day.
words.exampleZh: 活動在開幕日前獲得大量宣傳。

exercises.original: The event received a lot of advertisement before opening day.
exercises.zh: 活動在開幕日前獲得大量宣傳。
exercises.upgrade: The event received a lot of publicity before opening day.

options.explanation: 強調整體公眾曝光和宣傳。

exercises.original: The new product gained free advertisement after several newspapers wrote about it.
exercises.zh: 幾家報紙報道後，新產品獲得了免費宣傳。
exercises.upgrade: The new product gained free publicity after several newspapers wrote about it.

options.explanation: 媒體報道帶來的曝光通常叫 publicity，而非 paid advertisement。
報道本身不一定是廣告。

exercises.original: The controversy generated more advertisement than the company expected.
exercises.zh: 這場爭議為公司帶來比預期更多的宣傳曝光。
exercises.upgrade: The controversy generated more publicity than the company expected.

options.explanation: 爭議帶來的公眾注意和媒體曝光最適合 publicity。

falseSynonyms.zh: 宣傳活動不等於單一廣告 campaign 通常包含一系列廣告、渠道和策略。
falseSynonyms.point: The company launched an advertising campaign. One advertisement appeared on television.

falseSynonyms.zh: 海報不等於所有廣告 poster 是一種載體；它可以是 advertisement，但不是 advertisement 的通用同義詞。
告示不等於廣告 notice 通常是通知、公告，不一定有推廣目的。
公告不等於廣告 announcement 主要傳達資訊，不一定推銷產品或服務。
贊助不等於廣告 贊助可以帶來宣傳曝光，但不是廣告本身。
品牌塑造不等於單一廣告 branding 是建立品牌形象的整體工作。
